changes.summary: When updating a function data action, creates or updates the action draft using current integration_id, name, category, secure, contract, and config from Terraform state before uploading the function zip from function_config.file_path.
Retries fetching the function zip ID when it is not immediately available after upload, reducing transient apply failures during function data action updates.
Reads the latest draft version from the API before publishing instead of assuming version 1, reducing version-mismatch errors during apply.
Function zip uploads set an explicit content length instead of using chunked transfer encoding, improving upload reliability.
